items.title: Top 5 customers in SQL
items.prompt: Write a SQL query that returns the 5 customers with the highest total order amount, from tables customers(id, name) and orders(customer_id, amount).
items.output:
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 5;

items.title: TCP vs UDP in 80 words
items.prompt: Explain the difference between TCP and UDP in under 80 words.
items.output: TCP sets up a connection and guarantees delivery, order and error checking, so it suits web pages and file transfers. UDP sends packets without a connection or delivery guarantees, which makes it faster and lighter, so it suits live video, games and DNS lookups.
